material.title: Zeichenliste der archaischen Texte aus Uruk
material.responsibility: Margaret W. Green and Hans J. Nissen; Green's Sign List at pages 167-345; collaboration by Peter Damerow and Robert K. Englund
material.edition_or_resource: Archaische Texte aus Uruk, Band 2; Berlin: Gebr. Mann, 1987
material.requested_portion: Tier 1: exact front matter and table of contents sufficient to verify all component boundaries. Tier 2, only if lawful copying or research access is available: Margaret W. Green's Sign List, pages 167-345. A smaller representative page sample or reading-room route is acceptable if the complete portion cannot be supplied.

research_purpose: Establish exact bibliographic and page-level provenance for a historical Proto-Cuneiform sign list; compare its printed identity system with later reviewed scholarship and current PCSL/Unicode coordinates while keeping every source, concordance, reading, and interpretation separate.
requested_format: Lawful reading-room access, interlibrary route, or a source-faithful PDF scan with stable page order and the institution's copying and research-use conditions. No public source-file hosting is requested.

local_storage_conditions.retention_posture: Retain only under the supplied library or rights conditions; preserve fixity and provenance metadata; support expiry review and deletion.
